name: A powerful planted four-sword crossing execution, attacking
prompt: A powerful planted four-sword crossing execution, attacking RIGHT. Sink onto bent knees, draw BOTH arms up and backward to wind up. Pivot the hips and shoulders forward, lunge and slash both hand-held swords DOWN across the enemy space in front of the body in two crossing diagonal arcs, cyan from high to low followed by pink from high to low. Extend the elbows through each cut and recoil naturally. At the SAME TIME, the gold and purple hovering swords leave the back completely and fly ABOVE AND TO THE RIGHT of the fighter. They rotate independently blade-first DOWN through the target area in front, making a second large X-shaped pair of cuts. Gold and purple must be clearly visible in front of her during impact, separated from her hands and back. Finish in a low forward-leaning follow-through with all four sword tips forward and down. Bring both floating swords back behind shoulders, rise and reset guard. Real articulated combat motion, not hovering blades or stationary arms. No camera
